tests.name: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
tests.preparation_instructions: No specific fasting required. Maintain normal hydration.
tests.description: Measures red blood cells, white blood cells, hemoglobin, hematocrit, and platelets to detect anemia and infections.

tests.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
tests.preparation_instructions: Non-fasting test. Provides an average of 3-month blood glucose control.
tests.description: Evaluates long-term blood glucose regulation for diabetes diagnosis and monitoring.

tests.name: Comprehensive Lipid Profile
tests.preparation_instructions: Overnight fasting of 10-12 hours required. Water is permitted.
tests.description: Measures total cholesterol, HDL, LDL, VLDL, and triglycerides to assess cardiovascular risk.

tests.name: Thyroid Profile Total (T3, T4, TSH)
tests.preparation_instructions: Morning fasting sample preferred. Do not take thyroid medication before the test.
tests.description: Assesses thyroid gland function, hypo- or hyper-thyroidism.

tests.name: Liver Function Test (LFT)
tests.preparation_instructions: 8-10 hours fasting recommended. Avoid alcohol for 24 hours.
tests.description: Evaluates liver enzymes (SGOT, SGPT, Bilirubin, Alkaline Phosphatase, Albumin).

tests.name: Renal / Kidney Function Test (KFT)
tests.preparation_instructions: Ensure normal hydration. Avoid heavy red meat consumption before test.
tests.description: Tests Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN), Serum Creatinine, Uric Acid, and Electrolytes.

tests.name: Vitamin D3 (25-Hydroxy)
tests.description: Essential for bone health, calcium absorption, and immune function.
